$comment: Provider contract and provider-home resolution purity. Only resolvers in the owning provider plugins read configuration-home variables or assemble home-relative provider config paths. Exceptions name approved compatibility copies and fixed legacy paths independent of config-home resolution. New violations and stale exemptions fail.

entries.removedBy: Remove when support for the legacy ~/.claude/local/claude executable installation ends. The binary location is independent of CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.
